selection: 16 smallest SHA256(183-label-blind:+ID) among400 development IDs, then lexical presentation. Frozen before images/segmentations. No replacement or image selection by scores/labels.
hypothesis: Existing grayscale-derived watershed cells may be globally stable and visibly boundary-consistent enough to support later direct geometry. Unknown truegrain labels make this feasibility only.
baseline: Unchanged existing weak TV1.0*HHnoise, eps1e-4,maxiter50; Gaussian derivative sigma.7; h=.2*gradientq90; exclude markers on 7x7blackhat>Otsu; watershed_line=True. CanonicalD4 computed once onoriginal and shared for all probes.
variant_format: [h multiplier, ridge-Otsu multiplier, contrastfactor]. Contrast transform c*(x-.5)+.5 in float, no clipping/requantization, no spatial change. Adaptive HHnoise and otherexisting statistics recomputed. These are probes, not claimed generator distribution.
measurement: Count/medianarea/aspect(areaweighted) for existing>=16px regions includingframe; report interior andsmall separately. Watershed zero pixels nearest-label filled only to define a complete graph partition; this forced coverage is not evidence oftrue tiling. Match allcells by maximum-overlap Hungarian assignment, retain IoU>=.5. Matched sourcepixel coverage and edgeJaccard using4-neighbor graph; unmatched endpoints remain unique so they cannot create false matches. Allcell count, areadistribution and completepartition connectedness reported.
boundary_proxy: Rawcanonical gray Gaussian-gradient sigma1 top10% positive magnitudes, skeletonized, exclude3pxframe. Pseudoanchor only, not truth. Boundary=watershedzero; precision/recall distance<=2px. Fullraw/overlay/pseudanchor panels visually inspected for all16 withoutscores/labels. No manualresegmentation orperimage optimization.
gate: At least14/16 images must have all6probe maxrelative changes<=.10 forcount,medianarea,areaweighted_aspect AND matched sourcepixel fraction>=.90 AND adjacencyJaccard>=.90. Boundary proxy medianprecision>=.60 andmedianrecall>=.80 plusno systematic visuallyunsupported partition in>=2 images. These thresholds are feasibility policy, not materialtruth. Anyfail rejects this operational inverse-rendering route with existing segmentation; no furtherlearning/rescue.
tessellation_limit: We test globalpartition/cellidentity/adjacency consistency prerequisites. No fittedVoronoi/Laguerre/GBPD or inverse-rendering optimization. Not a proof ofmembership/nonmembership in everytessellation family.

paper.reading: Direct approach uses already segmentedgrain coordinate center ofmass/covariance andvolume, withoutparameter optimization. Itdoes not infergrainidentity from grayscale. Thepaperis3D; no automatic2D applicationclaim.

scope: Only fixed16 development images; no hardnesslabels/OOF/predictionarrays/holdout/test/full500/training/evaluation-image optimization/synthetictraining/externaltraining/install/download/payment/upload. ExistingNumPy/SciPy/skimage/PIL only.
